C0180.title: "Your Negative Review Has Been Deleted"—Who Did It? This Group Made 900,000 RMB by Fabrication
C0180.summary: Reports in March 2026 described an earlier Shanghai Minhang police case involving a corporate “online water army” that specialized in paid negative-review deletion for merchants. The group exploited platform moderation loopholes by fabricating extortion chat logs and mass-posting fake reviews, deleting more than 4,500 negative reviews for over 700 merchants, with the amount involved exceeding 900,000 yuan. Eight suspects were placed under criminal compulsory measures for suspected illegal business operations.
